items.title: EMBER: Predicting TCR--pMHC Binding Without a Docked Complex
items.abstract: We propose EMBER, a structure-based framework for TCR--pMHC binding prediction that eliminates the need for a predicted docked complex, and with it the placement error that dominates such predictions.
